d: France—a country where art and fashion hold a distinct identity; home to the world-famous Eiffel Tower; the most visited nation on Earth; the site of the world's largest art museum, housing the globally renowned painting, the *Mona Lisa*; and... the country with the highest number of time zones in the world. That is France—a land about which there is so much you simply must know. So, come join us on a journey through France, here on Infinity Stream...
